messages:
Iris (UX): quick idea from user testing today: people want a lighter timeline when iterating. proposing a per-invocation 'Condense' affordance (chevron + label) that collapses long tool outputs into a single line summary.
Arun (Frontend): do we want this global or per-invocation? per-invocation seems safest to start.
Iris (UX): per-invocation toggle, with a small 'Apply to all' option in the toolbar for power users.
Diego (Eng-ML): implementation constraint: some tool outputs are >1MB (logs). we must not render that inline when condensed. server-side stub + client fetch on expand.
Noor (Design): accessibility note: chevron alone isn't sufficient. need a visible label and aria-expanded state. Suggest label "Show condensed" or "Condense output".
Priya (PM): can we capture metrics: condensed_by_default, expand_click, recondense_count? want to measure whether condensing reduces noisy support tickets.
ops-bot: feature-flag created: condense-invoke -> staging.
Arun (Frontend): front-end plan: render summary row with tokens/ms/model; keep small icon for schema mismatch (tiny red dot) and an Expand button. store per-user preference in localStorage + endpoint for workspace default. estimate 2.5 dev days.
Diego (Eng-ML): backend: add endpoint GET /invokes/:id/raw and ensure the payload is sanitized (redact PII) before return. also we should stream for large blobs.
Noor (Design): microcopy: primary label: "Show condensed output". expand button: "Reveal full output". tooltip: "Conserves space; full output preserved. Click to reveal."
Iris (UX): UX detail: show a one-time coach mark the first time a user condenses to explain token savings and that nothing is deleted.
Priya (PM): rollout plan: default off, 10% of dev orgs first. track expand latency (must be <300ms), expand rate, and accessibility feedback.
Arun (Frontend): a11y checklist for the PR: aria-controls, aria-expanded, focusable expand/collapse, keyboard shortcuts (Enter/Space), and high-contrast chevron variants.
Diego (Eng-ML): perf note: deferred fetch should include ETag so we can cache locally; also ensure KV cache pointers remain intact for reruns.
Noor (Design): small visual: when condensed and schema mismatch exists, show a tiny badge "schema mismatch" with hover text: "Expected X; got Y" and link to the schema editor. avoids surprises.
Iris (UX): corner case: if a user expands, edits, then reruns, keep expanded state for that invocation.
ops-bot: deploy queued: condense-invoke -> canary.
Arun (Frontend): opening WIP PR now, will include mocked fetch and accessibility attributes. pinging @Iris @Noor for copy/a11y review.
Priya (PM): adding analytics event names to ticket: condense_toggled, condense_apply_all, condense_expanded, condense_recollapsed. will share schema.
Iris (UX): thanks — no blockers. will upload short GIF and final copy in this thread once PR is up. :sparkles:
